text:
liam: Heads-up: planned change window tonight 01:00-02:00 UTC. Scope: runtime -> v2.3.1, router -> v1.9.2. Need to confirm console readiness and a fast revert plan.
rachel: Console contract LGTM but we need the runtime to present legacy header when flag is off. We'll gate ENABLE_HEADER_SPLIT behind router pin.
quentin: Added a small dependency map in the PR: https://git.redwood/release/548. Key callouts: header compatibility, kernel-batching change, and KV eviction tuning.
maya: Suggestion: do a light canary (3-7%) for runtime, monitor error-rate and regressions on structured outputs. Router stays on current until T+30. If runtime problematic, revert runtime only.
zane: Also prepare KV fallback: lower eviction TTL to 20s for 10m window so we can clear warmed prefixes without long state. I'll stage the kvctl snippet in the doc.
deploybot: [deploybot] Running automated preflight: infra quotas, variant compatibility, smoke test. Result: infra OK, quant test failed on one model - investigating.
quentin: Which model failed quant? I saw the report: llama-13b-quant was flagged. Is that used in prod path for this release?
maya: Only used in some Dedicated routes. We can exclude that model from the canary via variant-filtering to avoid impact.
zane: I'll prepare a quick patch: `kvctl set-ttl --shard all --ttl 20s --dry-run` and a revert command `kvctl set-ttl --shard all --ttl 5m`.
rachel: Console will not flip ENABLE_HEADER_SPLIT during canary. We'll validate telemetry for header parsing for both patterns.
liam: Rollback thresholds we agreed: sustained 1%+ user-facing error-rate OR p95 latency > +60% sustained for 5m. Also high increases in 5xx from router side.
deploybot: [deploybot] Dry-run deploy commands attached:
```
/deploy runtime v2.3.1 --canary=5 --dry-run --exclude-model=llama-13b-quant
/deploy router v1.9.2 --pin=manual --dry-run
```
quentin: I'll watch metrics (Grafana dashboard link in doc). I'll set alerts for the exact rollback thresholds and publish to #oncall.
maya: I'll be primary rollback lead. If we need to roll back runtime, I will post ` /deploy rollback runtime v2.3.1 --to v2.3.0` and call the revert KV TTL command. Anyone else on rollback?
zane: I'll be on standby for KV commands and routing-table adjustments. Note: rolling back router is more invasive; prefer runtime-only rollback unless routing problems surface.
rachel: I'll ship a small console telemetry fix so logs show which header path parsed. That will help triage quickly.
deploybot: [deploybot] Preflight now PASS with exclude filter. Scheduling window confirmed.
liam: Final timeline: T0=01:00 start runtime canary (5%). T0+10m quick smoke. T0+20m full metric check. T0+30m if green -> pin router v1.9.2 and flip ENABLE_HEADER_SPLIT. Otherwise rollback runtime.
quentin: Quick note: add to release notes: "Runtime v2.3.1: batching perf improvement; safe header split guarded by console flag; temporary model exclusion: llama-13b-quant."
maya: I'll update the release notes and post variant ids once pinned. Post any last-minute concerns now.
zane: None. I'll stage the kvctl commands and an ops-runbook snippet in the doc for T-5.achel: Adding a small test harness to exercise both header variants now so we get early signal before T0.
liam: Thanks all. I'll post a T-10 reminder here and ping #oncall at T0. :thumbsup:
